scope.classification: Exact means the maintained source records a prior assessed unknown/uncertain grade and a later certain/confident grade. current_ledger_rows.subject: Daniel Glasgow (Glasgow-3896)
current_ledger_rows.evidence: The original 1849 Robert will names Daniel and Thomas as brothers; the original B465 deed of 30 July 1861 identifies the corresponding Irish beneficiaries by Kilrea/watchmaker/Margaret and Lisnagaver/farmer/Mary Anne. coverage_and_limitations.coverage: Searched the current and superseded relationship ledgers, all 93 structured relationship assessments, all 58 rows in the 28 September pre-1600 live correction history, the 46-profile Glasgow father cohort, the 26-profile pre-1550 relationship status audit, dated profile findings, and available git research history from 20 August through 29 September. The 1,009 findings.md files were inventoried by count; only relationship-relevant files were read. Current latest findings span 17 July–30 September.
coverage_and_limitations.why_three_ledger_count_is_incomplete: The current latest ledger has 9 rows, but it excludes 5 separately recorded uncertain→confident live/status changes (Jonet, Bryse, Isobel, Glassford and John-1030). It also excludes 24 unmarked→confident live changes and 5 dated confident edges whose prior grade is not preserved. Earlier followup rows are reconciled as corrected, duplicate/corroborative or ungraded rather than silently added.
coverage_and_limitations.public_safe: No raw captures, credentials, living-person data, browser state, live WikiTree edits or external web calls were used.
coverage_and_limitations.site_sync: Intentionally not run per task scope; root review is required before any latest-findings or website synchronization.
coverage_and_limitations.source_rule: Original source claims remain in the cited findings and assessments; this audit does not promote an inference to direct proof. Exact status changes are counted from saved live/status provenance, with scope and remaining identity conflicts retained.
